name.value: Fresh Tandoori Flavour Indian Restaurant Sidney

description.value: Fresh Tandoori Flavour is a multi-location Indian restaurant chain with its Sidney outpost on Beacon Avenue, the town's main commercial strip. The kitchen turns out traditional tandoori platters, curries, kebabs, and freshly baked naan using time-honoured recipes and locally sourced ingredients. Both dine-in and online ordering are available, making it a flexible meal stop for cyclists touring the Saanich Peninsula.

bike_parking_detail: 2 racks within 100m: rack (3 spaces) at 41m; rack (4 spaces) at 70m. Total: 7 spaces.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The Sidney contact page and footer confirm phone +1 250-655-4500 and address 2395 Beacon Ave, Sidney, BC V8L 1W9, matching OSM exactly. The front page 'Order Online' button and a dedicated 'Take-Out Samosa' line item on the Sidney menu confirm takeout availability. The Sidney menu lists numerous vegetarian dishes (Kadhai Paneer, Paneer Pakora, Vegetable Samosa, Vegetable Pakora, Aloo Tikki, etc.); no bike infrastructure, washroom, water refill, Wi-Fi, or charging information appears anywhere on the site.
concerns: Website front-page headline reads 'Authentic Indian Taste, Right Here in Victoria' despite this being the Sidney location — appears to be generic shared copy across all branches, not a factual discrepancy.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Legitimate full-service Indian restaurant on Sidney's main commercial street with confirmed contact details, dine-in seating, and takeout — a solid food stop for cyclists on the Saanich Peninsula.

Vegetarian / vegan / GF.detail: Sidney menu lists multiple vegetarian dishes: Kadhai Paneer, Paneer Pakora, Vegetable Platter, Vegetable Samosa, Vegetable Pakora, Aloo Tikki, Masala Fries, and others. No explicit vegan or gluten-free designations found
